issues.description: The problem description inconsistently refers to the animal feeding method as both messageOnFeed() (e.g., in the UML and earlier text) and getFeedingSound() (e.g., in the Part 2 method specification and song placeholders). The solution and intended API use messageOnFeed(), but the occurrence of getFeedingSound() in the problem text (and in the song example placeholders) can mislead students about which method to implement and call, causing compilation errors or incorrect implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across the problem statement, template, and examples. Replace all occurrences of getFeedingSound() in the problem text and song example with messageOnFeed(), and update any template comments or placeholders to reference messageOnFeed(). Ensure the UML, textual description, and example code all consistently use messageOnFeed() so students implement and call the same method.
